articles.headline: Salesforce announces AIforce layer to expose data, workflows, and governance to external AI agents
articles.summary: Salesforce’s composable AI layer is designed to let agents act across enterprise data and workflows with governance controls. This could materially affect productivity, process automation, and how businesses integrate third-party AI into CRM operations.

articles.headline: 1Password launches AI Spend and Consumption Management for enterprise SaaS control
articles.summary: The new capability helps organizations track token usage and rein in rising AI software costs across tools such as Anthropic, Cursor, and OpenAI. That matters for finance and IT leaders trying to control shadow AI spending and set usage governance.

articles.headline: OpenAI expects to burn through $278 billion on compute and infrastructure through 2030
articles.summary: OpenAI’s projected spending underscores how expensive frontier AI has become for companies building or buying AI infrastructure. The scale of cash burn matters to executives because it can influence cloud demand, vendor pricing, and the economics of enterprise AI adoption.
